services.name: Charter Flights
services.desc: Did you know, in addition to Helijet’s daily scheduled flights between our Metro Vancouver and Vancouver Island terminals, we can also help coordinate your custom charter? Helijet can help provide custom charter aerial support for business or pleasure. Let us find solutions for your getaway, corporate retreat, industrial needs, filming, sightseeing, and much more. Helijet has over 35 years of experience operating within the Pacific North-West environment, and ready to take off from our bases in Richmond-YVR, Vancouver Harbour, Victoria Harbour, Nanaimo Harbour, Prince Rupert or Sandspit-Haida Gwaii. The Helijet Fleet includes: Helicopters: Corporate Jets: Eurocopter AS350 AStar Cessna
